summary: Chiron Real Estate Inc. filed an 8-K/A amending its October 5, 2026 initial report to supply audited financials and supplemental operating data on its completed acquisition of The Pinnacle, a senior housing community in North Bethesda, Maryland, bought for $173.2 million under an agreement dated on or before the October 1, 2026 closing. The newly opened property was mid-lease-up: 5% occupancy at June 30, 2026, 31% at September 30 and October 1, with 54 leased units at $12,369 average monthly rent. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch lease-up velocity toward management's 2029 stabilization target of over 7% yield-on-cost.
